title: Federated pause-reason visibility: remote sessions' queue-pause reasons reach Central's listing and the exact-read routes for held wakes
outcome:
Scoped out of w-b63e1af0ce4c (local pause-reason visibility) by Termal::Fable2 on 2026-11-25, on the round-R2-1 review findings F5 and F6 (Codex delegation-88309b62, relayed by Opus-Causal in TermAl mailbox d84e975b #58).
- F5: the native-relay and central-domain exact reads return before recipientQueuePause is attached. A sender reading a wake held on ANOTHER host's paused queue sees no reason.
- F6: termal_list_sessions on the domain path shows a null reason for remote participants, because remote sync drops StateResponse.queuePauseReasons and proxy records never carry a reason.
Neither is a regression, since remote paths had no reason before w-b63e either. But DL560 s4's silence on 2026-11-23, half of w-b63e's motivating incident, was REMOTE, hence P1.

Wanted: carry the pause reason through remote sync onto proxy records (cleared on the remote unpause), and through both exact-read routes from the recipient host's observation. Use a permissive envelope only, never strict peer structs (the w-314a lesson). Behaviour tests for a remote paused session: Central's listing shows the reason, and a sender's exact read of a wake held behind it shows the reason. Relates to w-e8c7db25b458, whose resume action is per host.
acceptance: Federated pause-reason visibility: remote sessions' queue-pause reasons reach Central's listing and the exact-read routes for held wakes is done
